Title: CDRLabs.com - addlink Launches AddGame A95, A90 And A92 M.2 PCIe 4.0 SSDs - News
URL: https://www.cdrlabs.com/news/addlink-launches-addgame-a95-a90-and-a92-m-2-pcie-4-0-ssds.html
Published: 2021-10-11T16:02:22.000Z
Author: Ian
Highlights:
Both the A95 and A92 models are available in capacity of 1TB, 2TB, and 4TB. For A90 model, it comes with 1TB and 2TB varieties. Furthermore, besides the 5-year limited warranty, all three models also come with free addlink Toolbox software that allows users to monitor their SSDs on PC.
